title: Советские КВ станции, около 1970: Маяк, Родина, Атлантика, «Мир и прогресс»
license: unknown (off-air recordings by Dan Greenall, shared to archive.org opensource_audio; no licence stated)
notes: four Soviet shortwave services other than Radio Moscow, caught around 1970-71 by a listener in Ontario: Радио Маяк, Радиостанция Родина calling the diaspora home, Радиостанция Атлантика broadcasting to the fishing fleet, and Radio Station Peace and Progress — its interval signal and then its English service. Cut from the five archive clips concatenated in that order (offsets 0 / 23.25 / 45.71 / 70.84 / 88.67 s); the raw parts are kept beside the concatenation
